newsitem.title: USA: American General completes USLIFE merger.
newsitem.headline: American General completes USLIFE merger.

text.p: American General Corp said Tuesday that following shareholder approval, it had completed the acquisition of USLIFE Corp for $1.8 billion in an all-stock transaction.
The company said the integration of USLIFE is expected to be completed within 12 months and should result in a reduction in combined annual operating expenses of about $50 million.
The expected savings should make the deal accretive to earnings per share at the end of the first year, it said.

Based upon an exchange ratio of 1.1069 shares of American General per USLIFE common share and a projected 36.1 million USLIFE common shares outstanding at closing, American General said it issued about 40 million common shares in the deal, bringing the total common equivalent shares outstanding to about 248.5 million.
The acquisition is being accounted for on a pooling of interests basis, the company said.
